title: The Borrowed Inventory
author: Sebastian Yarrow
blurb: Wren Marchetti, a restaurant critic who has forgotten how food tastes, has spent five years practicing the art of almost saying it. Then a childhood home goes up for auction — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around before the house sale closes.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
